<thought>We need to determine how many carbonyl (C=O) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The most direct inexpensive measurement is the IR spectrum, which shows characteristic C=O stretching bands around 1700 cm⁻¹. By counting distinct carbonyl stretch peaks we can infer the number of carbonyl groups. We'll request the IR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
